concerns.text: The plan sets a success criterion of mean CV R² ≥ 0.6 (SC‑001) without providing a power analysis or justification that the ~1 k alloy sample from Matbench is sufficient to detect this effect size with acceptable Type I/II error rates.

Model training (FR‑002) uses a fixed RandomForestRegressor with default hyper‑parameters (n_estimators = 200, max_depth = None). No hyper‑parameter tuning or justification is provided, which may limit the ability to achieve the required R² ≥ 0.6 and undermines the methodological rigor of the performance claim.

The descriptor set (mixing entropy, δ, Δχ, VEC, Tm‑variance) ignores known confounding variables present in the dataset (e.g., phase structure and testing temperature) that strongly influence yield strength. The plan does not describe how these factors will be controlled for or incorporated, risking omitted‑variable bias.
